description: This file defines the PortfolioAdapter class, which extends ListAdapter to display a list of PortfolioItemUi objects in a RecyclerView. It includes a ViewHolder class for binding data to their respective views and a DiffUtil class to optimize list updates.

classes.name: PortfolioAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying portfolio items in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: PortfolioViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds the views for portfolio item binding.

classes.name: PortfolioDiffCallback
classes.description: DiffUtil callback class for calculating differences between old and new portfolio items.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the layout for each item in the portfolio list.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds the data from the PortfolioItemUi to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds the PortfolioItemUi data to the views in the ViewHolder.

methods.name: areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two items are the same based on their coinId.

methods.name: areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if the contents of two items are the same.
